accountsSubtitle: Where your money is: cash, bank and mobile wallets.
addAccountHint: Each account keeps its own balance.
accountNameHint: For example: Shop cash, City Bank, bKash personal
accountNumberHint: Stored safely. Only the last digits are shown.
accountNumberSaved: Saved as {{number}}. Type a new one to replace it.
openingBalanceHint: How much is in it today. Leave 0 for a new account.
openingLocked: The opening balance can't change once saved. Record an adjustment instead.
noAccountsHint: Add the cash box, bank account or wallet you use first.
categoriesHint: Group income and spending, so reports show where money comes from and goes.
transactionsSubtitle: Every taka in and out, with who recorded it.
needAccountFirst: Add an account first, so there's somewhere for the money to go.
typeHint_REFUND: Money you give back to a customer. Pick the income category it came from.
typeHint_ADJUSTMENT: Corrects a balance, for example after counting the cash box.
noTransactionsHint: Record money coming in or going out, and it shows here.
noMatchesHint: Try other filters, or clear them.
feeHint: Charged by the bank or wallet. Recorded as an expense.
referenceHint: Invoice, cheque or wallet transaction number.
needsApprovalHint: This is above the approval limit, so an owner or admin must approve it before it reaches the books.
duplicateNotice: This looks like another transaction with the same amount, date and account.
statusHint_DRAFT: A draft doesn't touch any balance until it's posted.
statusHint_PENDING_APPROVAL: Waiting for an owner or admin. Balances change once it's approved.
statusHint_POSTED: In the books. To undo it, reverse it: that records the opposite entry.
statusHint_REJECTED: Rejected, so it never reached the books.
statusHint_VOID: Voided before it was posted. Nothing changed.
waitingForApprover: An owner or admin needs to approve this.
cantApproveOwn: You recorded this, so someone else must approve it.
confirmBody_post: Balances change straight away. After this it can only be reversed.
confirmBody_void: It stays in the list, crossed out, but never reaches the books.
confirmBody_approve: It's posted to the books and balances change.
confirmBody_reject: It never reaches the books. The person who recorded it can make a new one.
confirmBody_reverse: An opposite entry is recorded today, so the balances go back. Both stay in the books.
confirmBody_dismissDuplicate: The warning goes away for this transaction.
attachmentsHint: PDF or photo (PNG, JPEG, WebP), up to 25 MB each.
fileTypeRefused: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP files can be attached.
fileTooLarge: That file is larger than 25 MB.
uploadFailed: The file couldn't be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
approvalLimitHint: Expenses above this wait for an owner or admin before they reach the books. Leave it empty for no limit.
